verdict.rationale: Plaid's API documents real-time balance retrieval, up to 24 months of transactions (including `transactionsSync` in the Node SDK), Link for connecting accounts, and Item status webhooks, so an agent could drive the core data operations programmatically. The official MCP server, however, is a Dashboard diagnostics and analytics tool, not an operational surface for creating Link sessions or pulling account data. The evidence also shows only Dashboard-issued API keys, with nothing on scoped credentials. Missing for 10: an operational MCP surface for Link, balances and transactions; documented scoped or least-privilege agent credentials; explicit server-side Link session creation and connection-management endpoints; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
